_doc: Bots on the easter egg (Update 04 section 5, T-067; gravelight/bots/bot_ee*.gd, docs/gravelight/BOTS.md). The setting 'Bot Easter-Egg Help' (GLSettings bot_ee_help): off / ask (When Asked, the default) / full (Full Partner). Each quest step's bot_task (data/gravelight/quests/*.json) says how a bot does it; these are the shared numbers.
_default_mode: T-086: Full Partner by default (the user: 'the bots should be able to do the Easter egg'); the saved setting still wins (GLSettings bot_ee_help, migrated once by settings.gd).
_full_commit_after_s: T-086: Full Partner and a step with commit last_input (the radio's third lock): the bot sets everything up, says the last one is the player's, and waits this long for them; then it makes the commit itself (EE_COMMIT_SELF). When Asked keeps the hand-off: an assigned bot never takes the commit. The player-bot agent (bot mode) is the player and commits at once.
_full_final_wait_s: T-086: a final step in Full Partner waits this long (from the first time a bot could have started it) for the player to be within presence_m; after that the bots do it without them.
_full_max_bots: Full Partner: at most this many bots on egg work at once (the rest stay with the player).
_presence_m: A final step in Full Partner mode needs the player within this many metres of its spot (and they must not wander off past 1.5x while the bot works).
_open_blocking_doors: A closed door between the bot and its egg target: it opens it with its own Scrip (affordable only), per mode.
_shop_break: T-153: a bot on an egg task with `scrip` or more (and not in a hold, at a door or making an input) pauses the task for `seconds` so its own economy can buy guns, perks and the Crucible, at most once every `every_s`. Without it a Full Partner bot never shopped while the egg ran (Totenhafen's squad reached the round-10 diesel holds with 7,000-11,000 Scrip unspent and was wiped).
_shop_break_u10: U10 T-172: the break used to buy nothing: the bot's economy still measured its ranges from the human (26 m) while the bot stood at the egg 40-60 m away. In a break (and between two steps, between_steps: a free rich bot waits `seconds` before its next pick) the economy shops around the bot itself within range_m, counts it as a round break (the Crucible), drinks perk_first before the rest of the perk plan, and may buy the closed doors on the way to the main egg's open steps. A break starts only when there is something to buy, and ends idle_end_s after the last errand when nothing is left.
_together: U10 T-172 (Kaltenbrunn's round 10-12 wipes, the squad split across floors): from from_round, mid-round (not the round's end or a break), a Full Partner bot whose nearest standing teammate is over max_m away (or another storey) pauses its egg errand ('apart') and goes back to the squad; a bot holding a running hold never pauses (the others rally to it, hold_rally). Full Partner also picks no step mid-round then whose spot is that far from every teammate.
_hold_rally: U10 T-172 (Totenhafen's diesel holds, the pylons): while a bot holds a running main-egg hold, every other free or Full Partner bot (not mid-carry, an input or a door) joins that step on the same anchor (one diesel hold runs at a time: the bots walked off to the next one and the holder died alone). From gather_from_round the bot about to start a hold waits at it until gather_need teammates (fewer if fewer stand) are within gather_m, at most gather_max_s, and the others come to it.
_start_wait_s: U10 T-172: a hold that waits for the player near its start (the pylons' start_needs_player_m) starts without them after start_wait_s in Full Partner, but only in a round break or before together.from_round (the pylons started late: the agent's plan took it elsewhere).
_egg_gun: U10 T-172 (Requiem s4 waited on a Crucible gun): while a main-egg step that needs an upgraded gun is still to come and no squad bot carries a taught gun, the richest bot with a long gun feeds it to the Crucible as soon as it can pay (no min round or min tier; the crate and the wall guns leave the price), from range_m around itself.

pause._doc: EE work pauses when the bot's threat pressure is at or over `pressure` (and resumes under resume_pressure, after min_pause_s at least), a teammate is down, or the round is ending (nothing left to spawn, at most round_end_left zombies up; for round_end_max_s at most, so a round that drags on doesn't stop the work), then resumes ('Back to it.'). Holding a zone keeps holding through threat and downs (that is the job). In Full Partner a task paused longer than full_drop_after_s is dropped and picked again later.

value._doc: The utility input ee_task while a task runs (actions.json ee_task).

scores._doc: Full Partner: which open step a free bot picks (higher wins; minus per_m per metre to its spot, at most 120 m). U10 T-163: main_quest 100 (was 70) so any open main-egg step beats every side quest (52 + 10 at most) whatever the distance: side quests only when the main egg has nothing a bot can do.

sight._doc: The squad's discoveries: a findable egg object (find: seen) is discovered once a squad member (the player or a bot) is within sight_m with a clear line of sight to it; an audible one (find: heard) within its hear_m (task hear_m overrides).

_hold_fight_m: Holding a zone: a zombie closer than this and the bot fights it the normal way (backs off, knifes) for that moment.
_shots_per_vantage: U10 (T-163): a shoot_target bot fires at most shots_per_vantage rounds from one spot without the target answering (a bell rings, the Chapel bell lights), then tries another angle (BotBrain.vantage_for avoid list); after vantages_max spots it gives the step up (missed). Counted per target.

jakub._doc: Jakub (the companion) does Collect, Hold and Carry (and stays at the side of whoever he covers); he refuses anything involving the Crucible or the perk machines, in character (JAK_SQ4_EE_REFUSE_*).
